Page.Name: page.custom.virtual
Page.Title: Virtual list (1M rows)
Page.Subtitle: Raven's ListView and Table in virtual mode: they store nothing and ask for the text of the rows they draw, so a million rows cost what the visible ones cost. src/vlist.c computes each row from its number and keeps only an array of indices for the filter and the sort. Scroll fast, filter, click the table headers to sort.

TextInput.Name: vl_filter
TextInput.Placeholder: Filter: a name, a city, a number...
